test_Commandline_sample: test the Commandline space sample method returns a valid flag index from 0 to N-1
test_Commandline_contains: test the Commandline space contains method validates whether an index is within the valid flag range
test_Commandline_to_string: test the Commandline space to_string method converts a list of flag indices to their command-line flag string representation
test_Commandline_from_string: test the Commandline space from_string method parses a command-line flag string back into its list of flag indices
test_Commandline_roundtrip: test the Commandline space to_string and from_string methods roundtrip correctly for a list of flag indices
